result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The main defect is a suspicious '-100%' discount badge on the pizza card. A few minor issues also affect contrast and consistency.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-100%' badge. This implies the item is completely free, which is almost certainly a data or formatting error (a wrong discount value) and could mislead users.
issues.suggestion: Check the promo data source and show the correct discount (e.g. '-10%'). If the offer is real, label it clearly, for example 'Free item'.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees under the 'Fastest near you' cards, the '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen' line, and the '(500+)' rating count) has low contrast against the white background. The search placeholder is also light gray on light gray.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colors to meet the WCAG 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: The white time pills (e.g. '15–25 min') sit over the food images and overlap the image edge, so they look cramped. The white '€0 delivery' and '-100%' badges are small, and the dark heart icon buttons have weak contrast over the busy imagery.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent padding and a subtle shadow to the badges and icon buttons, and make sure they have enough contrast over any image.

issues.description: The illustrated food images are inconsistent. The poke bowl card has a light background while the others are dark, and the images are flat vector art rather than real photos, so the cards look uneven.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent photographic style and background treatment for the restaurant cards.

issues.description: The badge styles are inconsistent. '€0 delivery' uses green text on a white pill, and the '-100%' badge uses the same style even though it carries a different kind of information. The pizza card also lacks the rating and info shown on other cards.
issues.suggestion: Differentiate badge types by color or icon so promotions and delivery info are clearly distinguished.
